purpose: Meshy 6 2k Cold Bastion broad-value matte source candidate

style.prompt: Stylized matte top-down game asset. Preserve broad near-black hull and pale shield zones: 70% charcoal/graphite, 25% cold mid-gunmetal, at most 5% pale ash-gray insets. Crisp seams, powder-coated armor, high roughness, low metalness, flat albedo with no baked highlights. Only the reactor and forward slits glow neutral white; keep three rear/west inset panels clean neutral white for later team masking. No white hull, chrome, mirrors, glossy clearcoat, marble, photoreal wear, micro-scratches, dirt noise, text, logos, decals, blue/red team color, or baked lighting. Preserve geometry.
